rationale: The bid-ask spread of 171.8 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that makes any directional trade extremely difficult to profit from, as price must move significantly just to cover the entry cost. The stock has gapped down ~6.3% and is trading near the session low with high volatility (ATR relative to price is elevated), but the 5-minute candles show wild swings with no clear stabilization or directional conviction — the last three candles span a range from $137.55 to $147.53, making reliable stop placement nearly impossible without excessive risk. Given the illiquid conditions, extreme spread, and chaotic price action in the opening minutes, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
